answer: We propose a protocol wherein dynamic opportunity-cost bonds impose a quadratic staking collateral requirement that forces identity multiplication into a fiscal nebula of insolvency. By deploying subgame-perfect punishment matrices, we ensure that slashing penalties exceed the marginal utility of any illicit node, effectively pushing the adversary over the ridge of profitability. As we approach the dawn of decentralized verification, our zero-knowledge delay proofs isolate sybil vectors, ensuring that negative expected attack utility anchors a robust Nash equilibrium.
